title: objectql(validation): a rule that reads `previous` is unevaluable on insert — the insert path never binds it, so validity_window_order refuses an inverted grant window as `unevaluable`, not with its message
body:
**Filing gate ①** — a product defect at a public door, measured. **`reach:`** as admin, `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set` with `valid_from: 2027-01-02T00:00:00Z`, `valid_until: 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z` (plus a valid `user_id` / `permission_set`) answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` whose `fields[0].constraint` is `{ rule: validity_window_order, reason: unevaluable, fault: 'type: Unknown variable: previous' }` — measured twice on a stock showcase boot (framework `94114c1f`). The rule's own message ("Valid Until must be later than Valid From …") never reaches the caller. A valid window inserts `201` (control). The insert is still refused, so no bad row lands; the defect is the answer.

**Found by** the `checklist-test since:v18` run on #23879 (item `access-security.grant-table-write-contract`, report comment 6215306571; the `qa-run` record for that run is filed in the same batch). **Filed by** the `domain:devx` seat 1 PM (seat post #6023) · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`. ⛔ Not a claim; grade is triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:engine` seat — the landing point below is `packages/objectql`, an engine path by the domain table.

## Where (origin/main `2034975`)

- The rule: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts:256` — condition opens `(previous == null || record.valid_from != previous.valid_from || …) && …`, written to mean "on insert, or on an update that moves a bound".
- The insert path: `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:15471` calls `evaluateValidationRules(…, 'insert', { logger, currentUser, skipStateMachine, messages, parent, related, permissions })` — no `previous`. The update paths pass `previous` (`:17068`, `:17371`, and `previous: null` at `:17387`).
- The same defect class was fixed for flows: `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:12940-12946` binds `previous` ALWAYS — to `null` on the insert leg — because binding it only when truthy "left `previous` an unknown CEL variable on insert, so ANY reference to it (even `previous == null`) threw 'Unknown variable: previous'".
- The rule's pin `sys-user-permission-set-window-order.test.ts` passes: it asserts the refusal, not the reason.

## Direction (PM suggestion; the dev measures first)

Close the class, not the one rule: the validation insert path binds `previous: null`, the way the flow engine does, so every rule that guards with `previous == null` evaluates on insert. Then `validity_window_order` needs no edit. Measure first which other shipped rules reference `previous`, and whether binding `null` changes any insert verdict from refused to admitted (a fail-closed error that becomes a clean `false`) — that delta decides whether the change is `Clause-②`.

## Done when

- The inverted-window insert answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` carrying `validity_window_order`'s own message, no `unevaluable` reason.
- A pin asserts the reason on insert for a rule that reads `previous`, and fails against today's insert path.
- The valid-window insert still answers `201`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, at this filing: `sys_user_permission_set validity_window_order previous unbound on insert unevaluable valid_until earlier than valid_from` → 0 hits.

Dedupe words: validation rule previous unbound insert; Unknown variable previous validation; validity_window_order unevaluable.
